name: U.S. Climate Normals (1991–2020)
description: The U.S. Climate Normals (1991–2020) is NOAA NCEI's official thirty-year baseline multi-product suite characterizing average climate conditions across approximately 15,000 weather stations in the United States. Produced every decade in accordance with World Meteorological Organization (WMO) standards, the 1991–2020 Normals suite provides separate official datasets for Monthly Normals (DOI: 10.25921/wck8-er13), Annual/Seasonal Normals (DOI: 10.25921/4ek7-fk11), Daily Normals (DOI: 10.25921/d3w1-ef83), Hourly Normals (DOI: 10.25921/e3zh-ag77), and Daily Gridded Normals (DOI: 10.25921/4z0k-n484). Variables include temperature averages, precipitation, snowfall, snow depth, degree days, and percentile thresholds.
